items.t: Peloton climbs on launch of $600M debut junk-bond refinancing
items.sum: Investing.com -- Peloton Interactive Inc (NASDAQ:PTON) shares gained 3% in Monday trading after the connected-fitness company launched a comprehensive debt refinancing plan anchored by a maiden junk-bond offering. The capital restructuring highlights management’s push to clean up its balance sheet and extend its debt maturity profile following years of operational turnaround efforts.

items.t: Peloton Interactive, Inc. Announces Launch of Global Refinancing
items.sum: NEW YORK, November 09, 2026--Peloton Interactive, Inc. ("Peloton") (NASDAQ: PTON) today announced the launch of a private offering (the "offering") of $600.0 million aggregate principal amount of senior secured notes due 2032 (the "notes") and the proposed entry into a $200.0 million five-year revolving credit facility (the "new revolving facility").
